name: Crisis line operations
description: Crisis center expertise for 988 and other crisis lines: the daily contact report, network surge and backup notices, queue and staffing boards, supervisor escalation, de-identified contact summaries and the state coordinator briefing, with the rerouting rules and service measures. Works with the behavioral health safeguards toolkit.
outsideParties: backup crisis centers in other states

advisorRoles.name: Crisis line advisor
advisorRoles.description: Answers questions about queue measures, rerouting and staffing as a peer center director would.

glossary.definition: Contacts offered to the center; contacts answered; contacts that left before an answer. Answer rate is answered divided by offered.

An unanswered contact moves to a national backup center: calls after about 2 minutes, texts and chats after about 5 minutes; Spanish-language contacts cannot be rerouted. GAO-26-108114, status as of March 2026; check the current rules.
The share of contacts answered by the center in the state rather than by backup; about 76% of calls were answered locally from July 2022 to September 2025 (GAO-26-108114).

productConventions: Show contact types separately: calls, texts and chats. Texts and chats are not reported by state in the national statistics.
Waits are written m:ss; times of day are 24 hour; every number says its hour or day.
The federal near-term goal is for centers to answer more than 90% of routed texts and chats by September 29, 2026; show it as a labeled default the center can change, not as a law.
realismRules: Surges follow news events; a center sees the queue before the dashboard shows it.
A supervisor escalation names the measure, what was tried and the decision needed, never the content of a contact.
Answered plus abandoned never exceeds offered.

criticalTasks: Activate overflow and backup before the rerouting timers clear the queue
Report queue and staffing measures to the state coordinator on a set schedule
Keep contact types visible separately so texts and chats are not hidden by calls
Keep crisis counselor staffing and breaks in balance with demand
Escalate high-risk consults to a clinical supervisor without delay
